reviews.comment: Great class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Respected

reviews.comment: Really nice lady but lectures are useless. Had to teach myself everything & TA's are very harsh when grading exams. Was 1 point away from an A & she never responded to my email's which sucks. She does give many extra credit opportunities but even with curved grades exams are everything and make up 80% of final grade. Definitely Go to help sessions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is a nice lady but a TERRIBLE lecturer. Nothing she says in lecture will help with the Achieve hw (which she herself can't always do so don't bother asking for help). The hw+iClicker grade is worth a pitiful amount compared to tests. they are graded very harshly with almost no partial credit. She says she'll curve grades. i dont believe her
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is a really sweet and caring professor. She is a well organized lab coordinator and all grading was prompt. Dr. Lim had a good canvas page and google drive. When it comes to the physical chemistry labs, she's definitely a great choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I enjoyed taking Dr. Lim's class. I didn't find the concepts to be too difficult. The most challenging thing was the homework.  315 is a math-heavy course, so most lectures aren't going to be "thrilling," but she does try to make it interesting by using demos. Don't make an enemy of 315, just accept that it's going to take some time to learn!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Caring

reviews.comment: Honestly the worst professor I have had. She is a kind lady outside of class and tries to make herself available but this is no conciliation to her AWFUL lectures. Be prepared to teach yourself the entire class. Tells students that worksheet answers keys will be posted but they are illegible or not posted. Exam averages were all in the low 60s.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is such a kind professor, and cares very deeply about her students and their successes. The course is intrinsically difficult, but she provides practice worksheets with solutions and lots of hw for practice. Come prepared to lecture since lectures are based around group problem sheets and in class questions. Don't procrastinate
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is the sweetest professor, and always made herself available during exam weeks. She brought us candy on multiple occasions and even had us do some fun activities during lectures. Lectures are sort of a flipped classroom style, I just wished that Dr. Lim would lecture more. Study solution scans and read the book religiously.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is a very sweet lady but she is not a very good lecturer, at least for this class. She has a shared drive with solutions from class which is nice, however they're not always guaranteed to be super legible or have the correct numbers. She is not terrible by any means but you can tell she got stuck teaching this course. Tough grader on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is a very sweet and caring professor. She brought us candy on multiple occasions and always made herself accessible for help. She also posted all the slides and problems for us to use to study. Make sure to go over the problems as they will be on the exam. Her lectures can be confusing at times however and material on exams can be unclear.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is a sweet lady who has good intentions, but I had to teach myself everything in this class. There is a large curve, but we all got screwed because exam 3 average was so good that she raised the grade cutoffs. The final is optional, but you have to have an average exam grade of about an 80 (hard to do) to skip the final and end with an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had this professor for chem 315. She was really enthusiastic about what she was teaching and it was clear that she cared a lot about what we learned. I do think sometimes that she goes through lecture examples really quickly. I did all of the practice for each chapter and the worksheets and did well.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She has a bad reputation but is actually super sweet and willing to help! Make sure you look at her notes for the test as she typically pulls test questions from there.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is so sweet. This is a tough course, but easier than Ochem. You are graded on 3 exams, homework, iclicker, and the final was optional for my class. Exams are really tough and there is never enough to finish them, but she gives partial credit. Be sure to learn how to do all of the solution scans very quickly to prepare for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took this class, q-dropped, had to take again. It's frustrating that there is only 1 prof for it, but it was okay to get through. First exam was rough - set yourself up for success and do the EOC problems. Second exam was hardest, third was okay. This is a hard class, but Dr. Lim is very kind and accessible via email/zoom. Pay attention from day 1!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: CHEM481 is the most god-awful course I've ever taken and it makes me hate chemistry with a passion. DO NOT load this onto an already difficult schedule.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is difficult and Dr. Lim is not a great professors. Because this is a small class, there are not a lot of resources out there for help outside of her office hours. I found Clutch prep to be very helpful for statistics on the first exam. Best advice is to pay attention to what she emphasizes in lecture and the EOC questions she posts.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this class as a test class required for my major, but worth 0 hours. I didn't really show up ever, it's satisfactory/unsatisfactory grading, but it was worth 0 hours so it wouldn't count in my GPA at all. I thought my time was better used to study vs attend a lecture on things I had already been familiar with such as study habits.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is not a good lecturer. She can be hard to understand, so try to sit towards the front & ask questions during class. Rework the examples from class to do well on the exams. The 2nd exam is the hardest so study the most for that one. The final is relatively easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm going to fail this class because she doesn't teach well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's not the best prof, but shes hilarious, and her class was enjoyable. Getting an A was really easy with her cutoffs.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim is very sweet but not the best professor. Her lectures were scattered so it was hard to determine what material would be on the exams. Her exams were based on her PowerPoint slides but she sometimes added questions that were more tricky. She does offer some extra credit and a lower grading scale which balances out everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This class seemed obsolete as most of the material was review from high school chemistry. The professor did a poor job at going over material. She would fumble around and not know what was going on most of the time. If class attendance was not mandatory, I would have not even shown up. Do not take this class if you are able to avoid it.

Dr. Lim is a super funny and compassionate professor. She's a mother at heart and loves teaching. This class is pretty detail oriented and the curriculum is all over the place, which makes it difficult to follow. But Dr. Lim does a really good job of providing notes and sufficient explanation.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: very nice lady, makes the class fun and enjoyable but the exams are brutal. they seem too long for the short amount of time given so have good time management. She says to study the lecture notes for the exams, but be absolutely sure you understand WHY they're done the way they are because she changes the questions in very tricky ways.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The tests in this class are the killer, you basically have to mindlessly know how to work the problems. She is quick in lecture and isn't too specific about solving problems. There is extra credit and a curve for the overall grade which helps.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Lim was an amazing Professor, I do not understand why she has such bad reviews. If you go to lecture, review your exams, and do the reviews she gives you, you will get an "A". She is very caring and funny at times, you can tell she wants you to pass the class. Plus sometimes she curves the grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very sweet and funny and class, she is very scary on test days though. Her exams are very rushed, I usually had to guess on several due to lack of time. I would recommend working through lecture problems, the free response are usually similar to them. Her curve is bomb. I made an A even though I probably had a low B. Also the TA Chris rocks!

The material in this class is easy and her lectures are good. Her exams are the toughest part of the class mostly because she doesn't understand partial credit. I recommend going over lecture problems to study. Participation is 10% of your grade so show up. The class has a curve in the syllabus and she gives extra credit which makes it easier

Dr. Lim is such a sweet and funny,  but unfortunately, she sometimes isn't easy to understand, especially when she feels rushed, that's when her accent gets worse. Don't waste your time asking her for help, she'll just repeat what she said in class. Her TA Chris is the BOMB. Test are pretty tough, the final was a nightmare. Should've gotten a B...

Dr. Lim is one of the cutest/sweetest professors I've ever had, & she is funny. BUT, she is pretty hard to follow in class. I learned more off the online homework and from doing the test reviews than from going to class. You do have to go to class to get attendance points b/c they help your grade a lot. HUGE curve at the end. I made a 74 & got an A

HUGE curve at the end of the year. Very unclear. Very difficult tests, NEVER enough time. She phrases questions in a VERY difficult way (overly so). Clicker every class but only 70% attendance gives you full points. HW wasn't too bad most of the time. She confused me way more then helped me and while she was VERY kind and sweet, would NOT recommend

She's funny and seems nice (except on test days).  Her tests have way too many questions on them for the allotted time.  She is very strict with time limits, doesn't give even a second over. If you skip her class, you will probably fail. She moves very fast, and I've never studied harder for a test in my life than her last one - 4 days (only this).
Really hard, but you'll get the grade if you put in the work

Dr. Lim is very difficult to follow as she moves way too fast. She is very intelligent, but really should stick to upper level chemistry. The best part is that she curved so much that even if you made a 74 you made an A in the class. She is not helpful in any sense. If you are looking for an easy A without learning anything take Dr. Lim.

Very hard to understand. Doesn't give you enough time to finish the Owls for the upcoming test. Continually holds the class 5-10 past the release time so she manages her lecture time poorly. I would not suggest this prof.
Not a very good teacher, but very nice and easy class
